_about: Default classification. Each tool call is tested against 'rules' in order (dispatch rules first, so a command that launches a worker counts as dispatch even when it runs from a script under .claude/skills, while editing that script counts as orchestration; add your own launcher scripts with prependRules and extraMarkers in a --config file); the first match gives its category, no match gives 'default'. A turn with several tool calls takes the category that comes first in 'categories'. A turn with no tool calls inherits the previous turn's category in the same session when 'sticky' is true. Patterns are JavaScript regular expressions, matched case-insensitively against the tool input lower-cased with backslashes turned into '/'.

labels.orchestration: building / maintaining the agent setup (skills, agents, hooks, settings, CLAUDE.md, dispatch scripts, usage tooling)
labels.dispatch: dispatch operations (launching subagents / other CLIs, writing briefs, reading reports, verifying)

rules.note: Claude Code subagents and messages to them
handing work to another agent CLI
touching agent configuration: skills, agents, commands, hooks, settings, memory files, MCP config
running usage meters and agent-setup commands
